senses.gloss: nibhanakti (cited in BR only once from the artificial Bhaṭṭ.; cf. AMg. ṇibhaṅga), breaks; pass. pple. nibhajyamāna, to be read in Śikṣ 〔230.13〕, see s.v. nibhunakti.

nibhā (= Pali id.), appearance, sheen: LV 〔255.6〕; 〔256.5, 10〕 (all prose). In Skt. recorded only as -nibha in Bhvr. adjectives; but the existence of the noun in Pali makes Wellerʼs note, 〔30 f.〕, quite valueless.

[nibhunakti, pres. pass. pple., acc. to text kadalīvan nibhujyamānāsārakaḥ Śikṣ 〔230.13〕. But Transl. of Bendall and Rouse assumes nibhajy˚, broken, citing Tib. bśig na, 〔217 note 3〕; this is surely right, since it accords with the usual fig. use of the comparison.]
